title: The Time Traveler's Wife
author: Audrey Niffenegger
summary: A librarian with a genetic condition is flung unpredictably through time, appearing at different points in the life of the woman he will marry. The couple has to build a marriage in which he is often absent.
readIf: you like love stories with a speculative twist and are happy to be emotionally wrung out.
skipIf: you dislike non-linear timelines, or find it uncomfortable that he visits his future wife when she is a child.

pairings.reason: Another time-crossing romance, with more adventure and history and a similar commitment to a single great love.
A lighter, queer romance with a time-slip twist, with a warm ensemble of friends.
Another tearjerking love story where time with someone is limited and every choice matters.
